facts.fact: Capital reports Ethiopia's non-bank mobile-money operators and payment-service providers are preparing to integrate with PAPSS, each needing a National Bank of Ethiopia Letter of No Objection first.

FSX Business reports Ethiopia became the 31st PAPSS member country and four Ethiopian banks have begun the regulatory process to join, awaiting National Bank of Ethiopia no-objection letters, with no bank yet operational.

facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports Safaricom extended M-Pesa Global to Ethiopia in October 2024, so M-Pesa wallets in Kenya and Ethiopia can make cross-border transfers, with Ethiopian customers receiving from M-Pesa Kenya.

Ethio telecom says its Visa Direct service lets Visa cardholders in over 190 countries send money to telebirr virtual card numbers, and its telebirr Remit app receives remittances from nine named countries (US, Canada, Israel, Saudi Arabia, UAE, UK, South Africa, Italy, Sweden).

Onafriq says M-PESA Safaricom signed an International Money Transfer Agreement with it, so individuals in Ethiopia can receive remittances from abroad through M-PESA, under National Bank of Ethiopia authorisation of July 2023.
